rows.text: When the vehicle is unladen, the valve reduces brake pressure in proportion to the load, limiting wheel lock. This prevention assumes correctly designed brakes and a dry road.
evidence: WABCO, Brakes and brake systems, §6.1.1.5, https://doc.wabco-auto.com/ProductFiles/anteros/Document/8150102173.pdf: regolazione in base al carico e prevenzione del bloccaggio a vuoto su strada asciutta con impianto correttamente dimensionato.

rows.text: The valve can sense load through spring deflection or suspension bellows pressure and adjust braking accordingly.
evidence: WABCO, Brakes and brake systems, §6.1.1.5, https://doc.wabco-auto.com/ProductFiles/anteros/Document/8150102173.pdf: regolazione in base al carico e prevenzione del bloccaggio a vuoto su strada asciutta con impianto correttamente dimensionato.

rows.text: The valve adjusts pressure to the axle brakes according to load: it reduces it when the vehicle is light compared with fully loaded.
evidence: WABCO, Brakes and brake systems, §6.1.1.5, https://doc.wabco-auto.com/ProductFiles/anteros/Document/8150102173.pdf: regolazione in base al carico e prevenzione del bloccaggio a vuoto su strada asciutta con impianto correttamente dimensionato.

rows.text: The valve adjusts braking pressure to the load; it does not control the height of the loading platform.
evidence: WABCO, Brakes and brake systems, §6.1.1.5, https://doc.wabco-auto.com/ProductFiles/anteros/Document/8150102173.pdf: regolazione in base al carico e prevenzione del bloccaggio a vuoto su strada asciutta con impianto correttamente dimensionato.

rows.text: The valve adjusts pressure to the load; it does not react to lockup at all brakes. ABS instead uses wheel speed to modulate pressure when wheels risk locking.
evidence: WABCO, Brakes and brake systems, §6.1.1.5, https://doc.wabco-auto.com/ProductFiles/anteros/Document/8150102173.pdf: regolazione in base al carico e prevenzione del bloccaggio a vuoto su strada asciutta con impianto correttamente dimensionato.

rows.text: The compressor draws in atmospheric air, compresses it and supplies the reservoirs that store it for the pneumatic circuit.

rows.text: A compressor, for example a piston type, produces the compressed air. Being driven by gears does not make it a gear-type air pump.

rows.text: Air controlled by the brake moves a piston in the converter, which actuates the hydraulic cylinder and pressurizes the brake fluid.
evidence: California Highway Patrol, HPG 83.2, cap. 6, figure 6-5 e 6-6 e §e, https://www.chp.ca.gov/siteassets/policy/hpg/hpg-83.2-ch-6.pdf: serbatoi aria, valvola a pedale, convertitori, serbatoio idraulico e cilindri alle ruote; il pistone pneumatico aziona quello idraulico.

rows.text: In an air-over-hydraulic system, the reservoirs supply the brake valve, which controls air to the converters downstream of it.

rows.text: The converter uses pneumatic force to pressurize hydraulic fluid, which reaches the wheel brake cylinders.

rows.text: The converter pressurizes fluid in the hydraulic circuit that operates the wheel brakes, not a lubrication circuit.

rows.text: Compressed air and brake fluid work in separate sections connected by the converter; they do not form a mixture with water.

rows.text: The converters link the two sections functionally: air force operates the hydraulic cylinder supplying the brakes.

rows.text: The quiz marks this FALSE. In an air-over-hydraulic system, compressed air is stored, while hydraulic braking pressure develops when the brake is applied. A small residual pressure may remain; both circuits still need to be checked for correct operation before departure.
evidence: Official CQC question 31263 printed FALSO; it does not specify pedal position. The explanation interprets its contrast as stored air readiness versus actuation-generated hydraulic service pressure, not an established official rationale.

review.review_evidence: Reviewed all 25 source questions and verdicts and four-language texts; no figures. California Highway Patrol chapter 6 sections 6(b),(e)-(g) and 8 directly inspected: air storage, actuation-generated hydraulic pressure, small residual pressure and inspection of both systems; chapter 3 describes piston compressor. WABCO 8150102173 PDF p61 section 6.1.1.5 inspected locally: load and suspension sensing and unladen locking under correct design/dry road. ZF ABS and differential explanations inspected. 31263 does not add a pedal position to question and preserves checks of both circuits.

issues.reason: Il quesito stampato indica FALSO per la necessità che aria e olio abbiano raggiunto pressione sufficiente prima della marcia, ma non specifica che il freno sia rilasciato. Le fonti consultate descrivono la generazione della pressione idraulica durante l’azionamento, senza chiarire se la formulazione ufficiale escluda una prova del freno prima della partenza o quale interpretazione giustifichi il verdetto.
